subject: Acme renewal: penetration test report & remediation summary needed for procurement gating
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2024 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: penetration test report and remediation summary for renewal gating

Marissa —

As part of our upcoming renewal procurement gate (MAP-5123) we need your most recent penetration test report and a short remediation summary. Procurement has a hard cutoff of Monday, Apr 22 to accept evidence for the renewal to proceed. Specifically we need:

- The final pen test report (redacted is OK)
- A one-page scope summary showing testing dates, target boundaries, and methodology (external/internal/credentials)
- A remediation status table (open findings, mitigation/ETA)
- Any vendor attestation or SOC2/SIG cross-references you have

If you can supply a redacted report and remediation tracker by EOD Apr 18 that would let us progress the gating checklist. Please confirm whether a vendor-signed attestation is available or if you prefer we accept a redwood-signed summary.

Thanks — we’re in late-stage renewal so this is time sensitive.

Jordan
Jordan Mills
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report and remediation summary for renewal gating

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can provide a redacted copy of the March 2024 penetration test report plus a remediation tracker and a short scope summary. I’ve looped in Karthik (security & infra) to confirm remediation status.

Plan/next steps:
- By EOD Apr 18: send redwood-pen-test-2024-03-redacted.pdf (sensitive fields removed) + one-page scope summary.
- By Apr 21: provide remediation tracker with proposed completion dates for remaining items.
- We will include a vendor-signed attestation where available; otherwise we can include a redwood-signed summary and SOC 2 pointer.

Are there any special redaction constraints from procurement (PII removal, IP specifics)? If you prefer a sealed access link instead of attaching the PDF we can do that as well — let me know.

I’ll escalate if any item cannot meet the Apr 22 gate.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-2841

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2024 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme renewal: remediation status and tracker

Marissa —

Quick status from engineering/security on the findings called out in the March engagement:

Summary (high-level):
- Total findings: 7 (2 high, 3 medium, 2 low)
- High findings: authentication token replay (mitigated with rolling token rotation + short TTL deployed 2024-04-10), CVE-2024-21378 in third-party dependency (hotfix merged, deployment planned 2024-04-19)
- Medium: info exposure in debug logs (config change rolled 2024-04-12), rate-limit gaps on public endpoint (WIP; planned rollout 2024-04-21)
- Low: documentation and minor config items (completed)

Attachments included for internal tracking: ACME-remediation-tracker-ACME-73.csv (rows: finding id, severity, status, owner, ETA).

Open items and mitigations:
1) CVE-2024-21378 — hotfix PR merged, staging test pass expected 4/18, prod deployment 4/19 (ETA 2024-04-19 23:59Z).
2) Rate-limit patch — work in progress; temporary WAF rule in place as mitigation; full change planned for 4/21.

We are comfortable providing a redacted report for procurement and a vendor-signed attestation for the remediation items that are complete. For the two remaining items with ETA after Apr 18, we recommend attaching the remediation tracker and an acceptance plan (post-acceptance verification window).

Happy to join a short call with Acme security if they want technical walk-throughs.

—Karthik
Head of Security Engineering

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2024 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report and remediation summary for renewal gating

Jordan —

Attached: redwood-pen-test-2024-03-redacted.pdf, pen-test-attestation-signed.pdf, and the remediation tracker (ACME-remediation-tracker-ACME-73.csv).

Short executive summary to accompany the attachments:
- Scope: external black-box assessment conducted 2024-03-12 to 2024-03-15 against the public-facing control plane and admin console. No internal/privileged network testing was performed.
- Findings: 7 total (2 high, 3 medium, 2 low).
- Remediation status: 5/7 findings closed as of 2024-04-18. Two items remain: the third-party CVE (PR merged, prod deploy ETA 2024-04-19) and rate-limit change (planned 2024-04-21). Temporary mitigations are in place for both.
- Attestation: attached vendor-signed attestation for the March engagement; where items remain open we’ve noted planned completion dates in the tracker.

Procurement options:
1) Accept redacted report + remediation tracker with post-acceptance verification (preferred if timeline is strict).
2) Delay gate until both items are deployed (if Acme requires all findings closed pre-renewal).

If you confirm option 1, we’ll provide a short verification plan and agree milestones for post-renewal validation. If you prefer a call, Karthik and Rishi are available tomorrow morning PST.

Please let me know which option procurement wants to accept and I’ll update the HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/record/ACME-73

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
